name: Venti Mesi
source:
A collection of playable stories about Italian Resistance and Liberation from Nazi-Fascism.

20 fateful months (from September 1943 to April 1945), 20 stories based on actual WWII events in the Milan metropolitan area (Sesto San Giovanni and its surroundings), 20 diverse points of view on Italy's history of democracy.

A narrative docu-game made with the support of Coop Lombardia for the City of Sesto San Giovanni's project "Oggi, 25 aprile 1945", in collaboration with Francesco Fontana (original soundtrack), voiced by Germano Lanzoni.

[From [url=https://wearemuesli.itch.io/ventimesi]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
关于意大利抵抗和从纳粹法西斯主义中解放出来的可玩故事合集。

20个决定命运的月份（从1943年9月到1945年4月），20个基于米兰大都市区（塞斯托圣乔瓦尼及其周边地区）真实二战事件的故事，关于意大利民主历史的20种不同观点。

一款叙事纪录片游戏，在Coop Lombardia的支持下为塞斯托圣乔瓦尼市的项目“Oggi，1945年4月25日”制作，与Francesco Fontana（原声带）合作，由Germano Lanzoni配音。

[来自[url=https://wearemuesli.itch.io/ventimesi]官方网站[/url]]
